title: Qualification run record, v1 (UND-13, REQ-INT-006)
description: What the model-drift canary emits: a new pinned provider version's structured answers to the qualification subset, compared case by case with the pinned baseline. GENERATED cases only (INV-22). The reference implementation and validator are benchmark/qualification/run.py; where this file and run.py disagree, run.py's tests decide and this file is wrong.

cases_sha256.description: Digest of the subset's case documents; must equal the subset file's and the baseline's.

pinned.description: What the service was configured with and asked for.

commit_sha.description: The commit the canary ran at.

answered_versions.description: Sorted, distinct versions the provider reported answering with.

result.description: DRIFT if any case drifted; else PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE if any case got no answer; else PASS.

version.description: A dated or numbered version; an alias such as latest or default is refused.

answered_by.description: The version the provider reported; null when it did not answer.

version_mismatch.description: answered_by differs from pinned.version: drift even when every slot matches.

items.description: expected is absent when the baseline had no such slot; observed is absent when the new answer had none.
